Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent sprite atlas, not a character poster.
Input image 1 is the ONLY pose-by-pose layout and animation reference and is the edit target. Input image 2 is approved Eula portrait: use ONLY its corrected Song of Broken Pines claymore design and its sword/body scale. Input image 3 shows the actual complete Song of Broken Pines weapon for silhouette reference; ignore all text/background.
Change only the weapon and minimal contacting fingers needed in EVERY cell. Preserve each original frame's character identity, face, adult head/body ratio, costume, hair, cape, body position, arm-action gesture, precise leg poses, foot placement relative to hips, and sequential motion. Do not convert poses into the portrait stance. Every frame retains exactly one complete body and one sword.
Replace all old short blue swords and spiky star-shaped guards with the approved long silver-white/blue greatsword: long broad blue-and-cyan blade with white edges and cyan linear motif, restrained golden curved wing-like guard with two small dark openings, navy straight two-hand grip and small golden pommel. Match image 2's much stronger blade mass. Weapon total length reads close to the character's full standing height, with a visibly long blade rather than an enlarged guard. Follow each frame's ORIGINAL weapon angle and current hand positions. Grip is one straight rod inside the hands; thumb opposes wrapped fingers; guard remains beyond hands; blade and grip are coaxial. No hand grips an exposed cutting edge. No detached handle or extra weapon.
Preserve the exact number of original frames and their reading order, atlas aspect ratio and rows/columns. Each full character, entire weapon, hair and shoes stays inside its own cell with transparent separation. If a larger weapon needs room, uniformly reduce that entire pose only very slightly within its cell; never compress or bend the sword and never change legs or lose the blade point. Maintain consistent human-body scale between all cells. No added camera rotation or strong foreshortening.
Genuinely transparent background, smooth alpha edges; no black/white/color backdrop, no text, labels, frame borders, baked particles, ground shadows, extra detached flecks or watermarks.
This sheet is RUN: exactly EIGHT frames in FOUR columns and TWO rows, 2:1 landscape (same atlas geometry as image 1). The user's favorite leg cycle must be preserved: top row right contact, compression, push-off, left flight; bottom row left contact, compression, push-off, right flight. Preserve every knee, hip and ankle bend, alternating legs, stride and boot orientation, low forward torso lean and flowing cape. BOTH hands continue holding the sword low behind the hip, blade trailing diagonally backward left, not swinging in front, not raised overhead. Enlarge/correct only the trailing sword relative to the body. No duplicated run frames and no changed torso stance.

Precise production sprite-sheet layout correction ONLY. Image 1 contains approved Eula animation poses with her new long Song of Broken Pines weapon. KEEP every frame's pose, leg angles, boots, knees, hands, face, costume, hair, sword design, weapon length relative to body, grip orientation, and all animation phases unchanged. Exactly the same frame count/order and the same number of rows/columns as image 1.
The larger swords currently cross invisible cell boundaries or touch adjacent poses. Correct this by uniformly shrinking EACH entire body-and-weapon silhouette to 91 percent of its current size, and CENTER THE COMPLETE SILHOUETTE (including every sword point) in its own equal grid cell. Do not center only the human and forget the long sword. Every sprite must have at least 16 clear transparent pixels on all four sides between its silhouette and its cell edge. Weapons must never touch adjacent cells or the outer canvas. Preserve a CONSISTENT human-body scale across all frames, no warped limbs or shortened swords. Empty transparent gutters are mandatory. Keep the exact artwork and poses as much as possible; only layout/whole-sprite size changes.
No visible grid, no text, no labels, no background, no extra copies or missing poses, no particles, no glow halo. Genuine transparent alpha. Remove isolated fringe fragments while keeping detailed real hair and metal edges.
This is exactly EIGHT running frames, FOUR columns by TWO rows, 2:1 canvas. All original eight legs, knees, boots and running cycle phases MUST stay unchanged. Only increase gutters around each entire pose. Pay particular attention to the first and second poses of the bottom row: the second sword point starts just before the first pose's toe ends, so separate these complete silhouettes with at least 20 transparent pixels. The long Song of Broken Pines and both-hand trailing grip remain unchanged.
